공통.장르: a cinematic live-action Korean app commercial

누구.SOYEON: the same Korean woman as in the first frame, in every frame — collarbone-length dark brown hair with softly curled ends, a light-blue chambray shirt under a plain canvas work apron, exactly as in the first frame. She does not speak; her lips stay closed unless this shot says otherwise.
누구.HANDS: Soyeon's own hands and light-blue chambray shirt cuffs, exactly as in the first frame.
누구.PHONE: her black smartphone, held exactly as in the first frame. Its screen is a flat, evenly lit chroma-green area with small white crosses in a regular grid — it stays plain green with the same white crosses, fixed to the glass, for the whole clip: never draw an app, a picture, text, a glow or a reflection on it, and the finger's edges stay crisp against the green.
누구.WALKER: a passer-by seen only from the waist down, exactly as in the first frame — dark navy trousers and white sneakers — carrying a white paper shopping bag with thin rope handles.
누구.PAIR: two passers-by seen from behind, exactly as in the first frame — on the left a woman with a short dark bob in a long camel coat, on the right a man in a gray padded jacket and dark trousers. Their faces are never seen.
누구.CUSTOMER: a woman customer seen from behind over her shoulder, exactly as in the first frame — dark shoulder-length hair, an oatmeal knit sweater. Her face stays hidden the whole time.
누구.GUESTS: two customers at the round table seen from behind and above, exactly as in the first frame — a man in a dark jacket and a woman with a dark bob in a cream cardigan. Their faces stay turned away as in the first frame.

공통.보기: LOOK: true-to-life cinematic commercial footage with a shallow depth of field and natural motion blur; keep the first frame's own light, colors, brightness and white balance exactly to the very end — no new light, no flicker, no color shift. Every printed photo in the scene (on a bag, a window poster, a sticker, a street banner or a wall frame) is a flat, still print whose picture never moves or changes. No added text, letters, numbers, logos or captions anywhere; never add a person or an object that is not in the first frame.
공통.소리: SOUND: silent clip — no dialogue, no narration, no music.
